spans.text: Inside the villa, where everything feels off in an uncanny way, an unexpected figure appears.
The Commander doesn't move. The muzzle of their gun stays pressed to Karven's forehead, even as they expose their back to the person behind them—Beluga.
Beluga, kill them!
Think my bullet's slower than hers?
Hahaha... You're not here to kill me. If you were, you'd have already pulled the trigger.
Who are you? Why are you interested in the Sewer Rats' business? Since we're at a standoff now... how about a little chat?
Though still sprawled awkwardly on the floor, Karven's greed glimmers visibly in the slits of his fat-sunken eyes.
...You really are disgusting.
The Commander lifts the knee pinning him down and steps back, standing up straight again.
Karven props himself up with both hands and struggles to his feet, fussing over the creased hem of his suit jacket.
Hahahaha... See? No one says no to money. In the Dark Zone, it's all just business—
He freezes mid-sentence.
As the Commander steps away, the distance between them grows, and Karven suddenly realizes—Beluga isn't aiming her gun at the Commander. She's aiming at him.
Beluga! Are you insane?!
Beluga doesn't respond. Not even a flicker of emotion crosses her face.
I'd keep my voice down if I were you. Call the guards in here, and you'll be the first to die.
The redness in Karven's face drains rapidly. He swallows hard and reaches up to wipe the sweat from his brow.
Don't move.
His hand freezes awkwardly in the air.
...We're all Doss' people. What are you doing?
Following orders. Cleaning up traitors.
Traitor...? Me?
Karven points at himself, incredulous.
Beluga says nothing. The muzzle of her gun bobs up and down slightly, like a silent nod.

I've served the Antonio family for years! I was already with them before Doss was even born! And now you—just some new face who's been around for what, two months?—you think you can call me a traitor?!
She's not wrong though, is she?
The Commander grabs the forgotten envelop off the desk, rips the seal, and shakes the contents onto the floor.
You forged the Antonio family's seal, signed contracts with the Sewer Rats behind Doss' back, and funneled the profits straight into your own pockets. I doubt this is the only thing you've done.
Karven's lips tremble. His tight suit shirt strains as he breathes faster, panic rising in his chest.
I don't know what you're talking about...
I'm loyal to Doss. He told me to handle all of this...
His voice trails off, getting quieter. But no one is paying attention to him anymore.
Doss sent you to kill him?
Yep. You?
We share the same goal.
It's been a while and there's still no noise outside. All clear?
Yeah. Mityl and Kuro are here too.
Then there's nothing left to wait for—
Wait!
Just as Beluga raises her weapon to shoot, Karven shouts in desperation.
I've got something to say!
I have evidence—proof you're a spy!
